title: Missing authentication for a critical function (CWE-306) in the management service (uavmonitor_usbv1) of the 1300…
description: CVE-2026-128907 is a vulnerability in the management service (uavmonitor_usbv1) of the 1300 communications board in DJI AeroScope Mobile (TP703) firmware 03.00.00.26 and affected 1300 communications board firmware versions. The service lacks authentication for critical functions, allowing unauthenticated local network attackers to read sensitive device information and change configuration settings via TCP port 16000 or the USB operator port. This vulnerability affects discontinued products with no available firmware fix.
